text: In the Lab 13 power-spectrum analysis, the fast bottom layer (Layer 1) shows a dominant spectral peak near the ___ Hz fast oscillation of the input signal.
explanation: The lab sets F_FAST = 50.0 Hz and F_SLOW = 5 Hz. Layer 1's high leak rate (α=1.0) lets it track the rapid carrier, so its power spectrum peaks near 50 Hz, while Layer 3 (α=0.1) retains mainly the 5 Hz modulation — the timescale hierarchy made visible in frequency.
